name: Fragility, Conflict, and Violence (FCV) situations
special_notes: Fragility, Conflict, and Violence (FCV) situations has replaced the previous FCS (Fragile and Conflict-Affected Situations) terminology. Until FY2027, a single Harmonized List of Fragile Situations combined "conflict" and "institutional" fragility. As of July 2026, the public FCV list includes countries where at least 20% of the population lives in areas with high conflict-related fatalities during a reference period. Along with a separted institutional fragility list, more information is available at: https://www.worldbank.org/en/topic/fragilityconflictviolence/brief/classification-of-fragile-and-conflict-affected-situations.
